parameters.content:
## INTEGRATION POINT

This node reads the output of `build_cohort.py`, which joins:

- **Zafar** - `outputs/uncertainty/uncertainty_predictions.csv` (MC-Dropout entropy, uncertainty_level)
- **Denis** - `outputs/explainability/shap/prediction_explanations.csv` (SHAP by ECG region)
- `outputs/calibration/calibration_metrics.json` (ECE)
- `outputs/evaluation/per_class_metrics.csv` (per-class recall)

Join key: `global_test_index == sample_index` (250/250 matched).

**Update the file path below to match your machine.**
Docker: mount the repo and use the container path.

## Governance runs on THEIR measured signals

No guessed thresholds. Every gate traces to a pipeline artefact:

| Gate | Source |
|---|---|
| uncertainty High | MC-Dropout |
| ECE-corrected confidence | calibration |
| class recall < 0.5 | per-class eval |
| SHAP region | Denis |

**Why escalate on High uncertainty:** their own metrics show accuracy 96.8% at Low vs **66.4% at High**. That 30-point collapse is the justification.

## BLIND-CLASS EXPOSURE

Per-class evaluation shows the federated model has **recall 0.0 on class S and class F**. It can never emit them.

So you cannot gate on predicted class - the model never predicts them. The gate fires instead on **uncertain predictions of classes it CAN emit**, which is the observable signature of a masked minority beat.

In the 250-record cohort: 50 true S and 17 true F beats are unreachable.

**Raise this with your supervisor before the demo.**

## HITL gate - read before writing up

The Wait node holds for **5 seconds**. That is a simulated pause so the workflow runs unattended.

Do **not** call this human-in-the-loop in the dissertation while it is in this mode.

To make it real: Wait node -> **Resume: On Webhook Call**. Execution then blocks until a clinician calls the resume URL.

## Demo cap

250 records x local 8B model = hours.

This Limit node caps the run at **10 patients**. Raise or delete it for the full cohort run that produces your results table.
